name: Enterprise Fund Committee Special Meeting Agenda 6-2-2021
agenda_text:
CITY OF EL MONTE

  SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
  ENTERPRISE FUND COMMITTEE
  June 2, 2021 - 6:00 p.m.
  El Monte City Hall West
  Conference Room A
  11333 Valley Boulevard
  El Monte, California

1.  CALL TO ORDER

2.  ROLL CALL

3.  FLAG SALUTE

4.  APPROVAL OF AGENDA

5.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  Meeting Minutes of January 13, 2021
  Meeting Minutes of May 5, 2021

6.  COMMITTEE BUSINESS AND DISCUSSION ITEMS
  Members of the public will be afforded an opportunity to comment and ask
  questions on each of the agenda items below but shall be limited to 2 minutes
  per person.

  A) Proposed Budget FY 21/22
  B) Urban Water Management Plan
  C) Water Master Plan
  D) Rehabilitation Elevated Reservoir
  E) Maintenance Purchases for Water and Storm
  F) Sewer CIP 005 Bid
  G) Selection of a new Chairperson and Vice Chair

  7.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATIONS

  8.  ADJOURN MEETING

  Posted on May 27, 2021 at 3:50 p.m.
